_classes.name: tax rate increase or new taxed class dropped by cap_not_duty

_classes.name: assessing unit resolved to Municipalities (all) or a county instead of Cities/Towns (or Nassau County for the special assessing unit)
_classes.rule: re.search(r'(?i)assessing unit', actor_raw+' '+quote) and agency not in (Cities, Towns, Counties, New York City, Villages)

_classes.name: base-proportion cap stored as its own duty beside the 'shall alter' duty
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and re.search(r'(?i)current base proportion of any class shall not exceed', quote)

_classes.name: junk agency or agency_unit copied from the actor phrase
_classes.rule: re.match(r'(?i)^no\b', agency_unit) or re.search(r'(?i)trustees? or sole trustee|^no |^every ', agency)

_classes.name: list item held as power against a mandatory lead-in (recurrence of Oct 17 fix)
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and quote starts with a bare imperative verb (Provide|Establish|Develop|Promulgate|Conduct|Issue|Maintain|Prepare|Create|Submit|Report|Adopt|Make|Review|Implement) and no may/authoriz/empower/power/permit in quote

_classes.name: condition or report content stored as a power ('may consider', 'report may include recommendations')
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and re.search(r'(?i)\bmay consider\b|report may include|may include recommendations', quote)
_classes.note: broad regex; some 'may consider' hits will be real discretionary powers

_classes.name: choice-of-law 'shall be governed by' stored as a duty

2009-S4601-14.quote: Any municipality, school district or district corporation may issue deficiency notes during any fiscal year to Finance a deficiency in any fund or funds arising from revenues being less than the Amount estimated in the budget for such current fiscal year.

2009-S4601-15.quote: Such notes may be issued in such Amount as the Finance board shall determine to be necessary, but not to exceed five per centum of the Amount of the annual budget of such municipality, school district or district corporation.

2009-S4601-16.quote: Deficiency notes may be renewed from time to time, but such notes, including the renewals thereof,

2009-S4601-17.quote: such notes, including the renewals thereof, shall mature not later than the close of the fiscal year succeeding the fiscal year in which such notes are issued.

2009-S4601-18.quote: However, such notes, including the renewals thereof, may mature not later than the close of the second fiscal year succeeding the fiscal year in which such notes are issued

2009-S4601-19.quote: Deficiency notes shall be redeemed out of the taxes or assessments levied or to be levied for the fiscal year in which they mature or out of other revenues of that fiscal year legally available for that purpose.

2009-S4601-20.quote: any municipality, school district or district corporation, which has the Power to issue deficiency notes under This section, shall to the same extent have the Power to appropriate and expend money Received from the proceeds of the sale of deficiency notes for the purposes of the fund or funds for which such notes are issued.

2009-S4601-21.quote: The proceeds of such notes shall be used only to Finance a deficiency in any fund or funds arising from revenues being less than the Amount estimated in the budget for the current fiscal year

2009-S4601-22.quote: shall be subject to the requirements of paragraphs C, D, E and f of section 10.10 of This article for three years commencing with the fiscal year in which such notes were renewed or each second successive fiscal year in which such notes were issued.

2009-S4601-23.quote: The issuance of deficiency notes or renewals thereof shall be authorized by a "deficiency note resolution". Each such resolution shall be properly dated and shall bear a title which will indicate that it relates to a deficiency note.

2009-S4601-24.quote: Any municipality, school district or district corporation may adopt One or more deficiency note resolutions authorizing the issuance of deficiency notes for the specific object or purpose of covering a deficiency in any fund or funds arising from revenues being less than the Amount estimated in the budget

2009-S4601-25.quote: A deficiency note resolution shall contain, in substance, at least the following provisions: 1. A statement of the specific object or purpose for which the deficiency notes to be authorized by such resolution are to be issued;

2009-S4601-26.quote: Every deficiency note resolution shall be adopted by at least a majority vote of the voting strength of the Finance board.

2009-S4601-27.quote: A two-thirds vote of the voting strength of the Finance board shall be required to adopt a deficiency note resolution authorizing the issuance of renewal notes or authorizing the issuance of deficiency notes in a year next succeeding a year in which deficiency notes were issued.
